avis.texte: It's hard to find a sunscreen that is completely mineral and doesn't make you smell like the beach, so I was excited to try this. I really like the way it applies without a greasy feel or bad smell. I use it daily when leaving the house. I love it!

When I recieved my bottle I noticed butylocytl salicylate is listed as the third ingredient. For some reason Ulta does not have this ingredient listed on the website. It is a chemical filter - which means this product is being falsely marketed as a mineral sunscreen, when it is in fact not. Very deceptive.

I would prefer a mineral sunscreen and had high hopes for Vacation's BUT…it still left a white cast. Womp-womp. However, the texture was smooth and even slightly matte and would make a great primer, so I would recommend it to all my white friends but I would not recommend to any of friends with melanin!

I got this sunscreen because it has less chemicals than other sunscreens being mineral based. I went to the beach for 2.5 hours and applied 3 seperate times. The sunburn I have is unreal!! I'm born and raised in Florida, and a sunscreen has never dissapoitned me more than this one. It's a very thick consistency so it's hard to rub in fully. I didn't mind because I thought I'd be more protected from the sun. Not the case. It feels as if I didnt use any sunscreen at all.

Went through a whole tube, and then repurchased with order date June 18 2024. it's now July 2025. I happened to check my expiration date on the tube, out of curiosity today, and it expired April 2025. Not sure how long this was sitting in a distribution center, but sunscreens are supposed to have expiry date of 3 years from manufacture. I probably only used half the product. I'm going to have to throw it out. Disappointing

I choose this sunscreen due to it being reef friendly. I have sensitive skin and my husband has eczema and neither of us had any reaction. We both didn't have white cast (just fyi, I am light/medium olive), but my 18 year old did, but he also struggled rubbing it in on his face. My husband burns even in the shade with spf, abd did not burn at all using this.
I bought this a couple of weeks ago and use it daily. It's a nice weight, goes on with a bit of a white cast, but let it sink in and I don't notice it at all. Feels clean, not greasy. Great work!

avis.titre: I didn't think the white cast was awful but…
avis.texte: I personally found that this product didnt leave too terfible of a white cast but woke up the next morning after using it with a rash everywhere I put the sunscreen. I guess im allergic because this was the only new thing I've used recently.

My skin has been red from over exfoliating. When i put this on it reduces the redness and makes my skin look great! I feel i dont need muxh makeup after. The ingredients are great and it works so well to calm skin. Being a mineral sunscreen is the icing on the cake!
Expensive and hated the white residue it left on my skin. No amount of rubbing took it away...

Hands down the best sunscreen I've used. Smooth, easy to blend in, leave no significant white cast behind. Not as slippery as Mdsolarscience mineral sunscreen. And super affordable. Wish they make SPF 50. This is definitely my to go sunscreen from now on.
this was super bendable and Does not leave a white cast! good sun coverage too I noticed I actually tanned rather then burn. only wish it had the popular vacation scent

The last 2 tubes of these have been so great compared to the very first I bought long ago. They dry on with no shine and into skin. Able to use on both face and body. The tube dispenses consistently and stand upright making it easy to use. It's on permanent rotation.
The moment I saw it knew I would love it! It's lightweight, smells good and I like that it's spf 50.
The finish is nice, doesn't make me break out. 2 complaints- If the bottle was 3 oz instead of 3.4 I could travel with it. Also, it kinda smells like sandwich bread??

I have loved vacations products for a long time now and within the past year switched to the mineral sunscreen, staying away from chemical based lotions. I LOVE this mineral sunscreen! Recently was in Hawaii where the UV was 11, and this stuff protected me and I arrived home with ZERO sun burns and a tan. Highly recommend this stuff, use it on my face, hands, body, everywhere!
As a woman of color, i really like this sunscreen! It doesnt leave a whitw cast and it asorbs nicwly into the skin. I have combo to normal skin.

So i really do like this sunscreen. Its very comfortable, doesnt have a white cast, and didnt pill in combination with my other products. I found this to be MUCH better than the whipped foam sunscreen that blew up on tiktok. The only reason i am giving this 4 stars is because the skin on my face is incredibly sensitive so i got red, irritated and dry after using this on my face for a few days. I know its no fault of the product though because my neck and body didn't have a reaction. I would say definitely give this a try it was one of the most comfortable and user friendly mineral sunscreens ive ever tried! If you have hypersensitive skin then i would skip.
Have been using this product and I love it. It goes on easy, great UV perfection without all the chemicals.
Omg absolutely love this sunscreen! No white cast, smooth, moisturizing and overall great! Gave me super glowy look without being greasy !

I thought id give this sunscreen a try since it was on sale and i saw pretty good reviews about it. I saw some people mention the smell but i decided to give it the benefit of the doubt and just try it. Judging by the photos, i thought this would be a tinted sunscreen but when i got it, it was completely white which i didnt mind since it didnt mention anywhere that it was tinted. The application was also just okay; it felt like a normal greasy sunscreen but i didnt really mind it. Im a little tan so when i applied this on my legs, it left a bad white cast, it made me look ashy lol. Not to mention the smell, its tolerable but it just smells like a wet towel to me.

a lot of people talk abt the smell of this sunscreen but i love it ! i cant stand the smell of sunscreen but this one doesnt have that smell. as for the consistency, it is very oily, however, its good for a natural glow. it sits VERY well on the face. i couldnt find a good tinted mineral sunscreen, so i mix this abd the halo glow foundation by elf and its PERFECT. it doesnt clog my pores (even tho its oily and i have oily/combo skin) and it makes the 'clean girl' makeup pull through.

Bought this for a vacation in the USVI. It was easy to rub in (for a mineral sunscreen that is) and didnt really leave a bad white cast. However, the smell was horrific. The smell was intensified after swimming in the ocean. My husband kept saying "something smells like cheap cigarettes" only to realize it was us. It stays on really well in the water though… almost too well. Found myself scrubbing body wash 2-3x in the shower to get rid of the smell. Despite that, it did the job and i suprisingly didnt burn under the carribean sun, but unfortunately i cannot buy this product again because of the smell.

This has amazing ingredients and rates 100 out of 100 on the Yuka app. I feel good knowing there isn't anything bad in it and it will sooth and protect my skin. I've been searching a long time for a good sunscreen that wasn't too expensive and had clean ingredients. Super happy I found this product!
This smells so bad!! Definitely returning. No one wants to smell like this in the summer time.

I have a tan, southeast Asian complexion and I hate wearing sunscreen because most sunscreens I've come across leave me feeling sticky and greasy, despite hours after application. As we age, I understand that it is necessary to have some sort of sun protection even if I know I won't be spending all day outside! I currently use low-dose granactive retinoid on my body which will cause my skin to be a little more photosensitive when outside. I have had my eyes on the Vacation Inc brand this last month because of how cute the packaging is and the nostalgia it brought me (I'm a 90's baby), so I finally made the jump to purchase during the BOGO 50% sale. I wasn't expecting much out of it but upon application of the Mineral SPF 30 I immediately fell in love! I was anticipating the smell but didn't realize that it is unscented, which I had no problem with. The consistency is almost on the thin side, a little runny--kind of reminds me of a tinted moisturizer. It is easily spreadable and while I do feel slight stickiness upon application, I was pleased to find that it does eventually dry down leaving the skin feeling moisturized but not too matte. I don't feel "hot" like I generally do when I apply sunscreen which is great. Really hoping Ulta & Vacation Inc. continues to sell this product and that they release a higher SPF rating!

When it comes to mineral sunscreens, I have tried alot of them. Last summer, I would have said Native sunscreen was my favorite. But I love this!!! I love how moisturizing it is, particularly because I have dry skin. This is a repurchase for sure. (Yes, only 15.5% zinc oxide.)

Went to Maui where only mineral sunscreen is allowed, so I stocked up on several different types before leaving and this was far and away my favorite for body. Mineral sunscreens can feel so thick and chalky but this one goes one like one of my chemical favorites, coola. Skin felt very protected while wearing this, I only wish the spf were higher. This left no white cast at all on our fair/medium skin, if anything skin felt a little dewy/oily after application, but I liked that! Will definitely repurchase.

I recently had skin cancer removed from my face for the 4th time and the plastic surgeon said to get mineral sunscreen with at least 20% zinc oxide. I bought this and the ingredients list on the tube state it contains 15.5%. zinc oxide.........so the search continues.

I really wanted to love this sunscreen and was so excited to try it but unfortunately my skin did not take well to it. Thankfully, I had just used it on my arms and neck so when I broke out into a rash on these areas, I knew it was because of the sunscreen. I gave it two stars because it blended very nicely and didnt leave a white cast but it just wasnt for me. I have rosacea and very sensitive skin overall so it may just be me, but definitely do a spot test before you use it all over.

I was looking for a mineral suncreen that didnt have any actives harmful to aquatic ecosystems to wear as an every day sinscreen. This one fit the bill perfectly, but im not sure its great as an everyday sunscreen. It goes on quite thick and i end up pulling at my skin more than i would like. It does slightly smell and feel more like clay so heads up if you don't like that smell. I didnt mind it. Overall i think its wonderful and safe for the environment.

It seems to work fine. Goes on white but that goes away quickly. e Although the expiration date is almost a year from the date purchased, it smells old, like it has been sitting on the shelf for too long.

My kids are fair skinned and have awful reactions to any chemical SPF, so mineral is all we are able to use. This is by far my favorite mineral sunscreen, and we have tried many. They've never gotten even a hint of sunburn using this. It is thin but not watery and spreads so easily. There is also no scent.

I love a good mineral formula, but this one does not smell good at all. Their other formulas smell so good that I was expecting this to be more than what it was. Either pick a different mineral formula or by their regular formulations.

avis.titre: Great for Sensitive Skin and Actually Works!
avis.texte: I have very sensitive, acne-prone skin but this sunscreen has caused 0 problems! It also leaves the most minimal white cast (if any really) of all the brands I've tried, which is double the amazing because it's zinc oxide level is 20%. It is a heavier, but I just don't use moisturizer beforehand (very combo skin) and kind of like the glow it leaves :) After a long boat day, can vouch for it's waterproofness too. But it will turn white if you sweat a lot and it wipes off on clothes, but its a physical sunscreen, so that makes sense.

avis.titre: Order 2 more after I complete 1 one
avis.texte: Really like this sunscreen. Basically Comfy. Think will use more.

avis.titre: Shipped fast and sunscreen works well.
avis.texte: Arrived fast and rubs in well! I tested it out on kayak trip recently, and the one spot I didn't use sunscreen was burned. So it works!
It's easy to put on my face and my body. No scent. I feel like it is really protecting and soothing my skin. Please make a larger bottle!

This is a very good mineral sunscreen! Rubs in well and leaves very little/if any white cast on my skin, which is pretty light with pink undertones. The scent is as "unscented" as you can get, which is great because some mineral sunscreens smell like crayons. It is also very, very waterproof- I need to use an oil based cleanser and washcloth to remove it, but it has not yet caused me to break out which is HUGE. Every sunscreen I have ever tried gives me skin problems, but so far this one has not which I am very impressed by. It is kind of "hot" feeling tho, because sweat beads up on my skin due to how water proof it is. But it works very well for exercising outside in California sun and doesn't break me out, so it's a win! It does get a bit of a white cast when it gets wet, but it's not egregious at all- just gives classic sunblock vibes

I don't like the way heavy unscreens feel and this one is super heavy. It doesn't dry down and will get on everything you touch, so I recommend only using for the pool and beach. I used it to go on a hike and when I was in my car, I got sunscreen on everything from it transferring from my arms. It's VERY thick. I do like that there is no fragrance and the skincare ingredients did leave my skin soft after washing this off, but I don't think I'll repurchase.
Fantastic mineral lotion…goes on so easily and feels great. I wish it had the scent of the classic lotion though!
Lightweight and silky, doesn't irritate my face or dry out my skin.
Has no smell and makes your face very shiny. Would like to return

avis.titre: Love!! No white residue, no icky thick feel
avis.texte: Was soooo shocked by this product. It's better than I could have imagined. Unscented as far as I can tell...

I only use mineral sunscreen in lotion form (for personal and environmental health reasons), so I've tried quite a few varieties. This is hands down the best sunscreen out there. The white cast is minimal on us, but we are a fair-skinned family. I reapply regularly as directed and none of us have ever burned with this cream. Great protection, goes on smooth, blends well…we will repurchase often!
Wonderful for the face. I have sensitive skin and I also burn easily. This lotion has been absolutely amazing for protecting my face.

I found that it doesn't ever really dry down, it remains pretty tacky compared to some other mineral sunscreens I've tried. It probably wouldn't be a good choice for deeper skin tones, I'm on the fairer side and it has a noticeable enough white cast that I would be self conscious to wear it outside the house/yard. I will finish the bottle, but won't repurchase.

Amazingly surprised at how beautifully this wore!! It is. Physical sunscreen so don't expect miracles there will be a tiny white cast, but once it's worked into the skin it's barely noticeable! And left my skin so SOFT! I have a mineral sunscreen specifically for the face that I've used forever (kinship self reflect) and I absolutely love that one, this doesn't specifically say it's for the face so I thought this would be more of a body sunscreen or one to wear to the beach when you don't care too much about it "looking like sunscreen" but I was able to use this on my face and it looked beautiful and wore fabulously!
This one is a white cast villain. Also, not for combination or oily skin especially in humidity. I have light medium skin and the amount needed for actual spf 30 coverage is an absolute clown base.
This sunscreen is one of the best. I have tried too many. It feels creamy and applies like a primer. My skin is sensitive and irritable, but this sunscreen makes it feel and look so good!!
Awesome!!!!! A must on my rotation specially when my skin feels dehydrated.... love love this sunscreen!

This is a great mineral sunscreen. It's not heavy. It wears well under makeup and doesn't pill. It's smooth and has minimal white cast. I wish they offered a higher SPF! I don't like chemical sunscreens, but thinking about trying there's because this is so good!
Leaves such a good smell and let's me get a tan without burning!

avis.titre: This does leave a white cast
avis.texte: This does leave a white cast on the face. Its not horrible but I would not feel comfortable leaving the house. I am white and makes me look like a ghost. Its a nice lotion and blends in. Some days it made my skin feel like it was burning when i put it on bc my skin was sensitive that day. If u re-apply as u should, the white cast just gets worse.

avis.titre: perfect for long beach days with kids
avis.texte: Perfect for long days at the beach, particularly for my two young children. I appreciate how safe, unscented, and easy to apply this sunscreen is.
I felt transported back to the 80s with this incredible mineral lotion
Smells great. Good sun protection and no white cast! I can't wait to finish so I can start another one. I'm planning to buy back up.
Love this sunscreen. Reminiscent of poolside piña coladas and chlorine - in a good way.

avis.titre: Some lotions don't have minerals. Why settle?
avis.texte: The main things I liked were the minerals, which added a great deal to the lotion.

avis.titre: It protects sensitive spots really well
avis.texte: It protects! I used it on my shoulders, face and ears and have not gotten burned. It doesn't have the same smell as other Vacation products, but it protects my skin really well in the water and on the beach.

Finally, an unscented mineral sunscreen that hydrates and gives my skin a nice glow. Minimal white cast, really only noticeable when you're in water. Highly recommend and please, make us a bigger bottle!
I have searched high and low for the perfect mineral sunscreen, and this is IT! Great protection, rubs in quickly and doesn't leave a white residue.
Fantastic fragrance and not greasy at all. Lasted a really long time and I didn't get burnt once while snorkeling all day in Maui.
Some of the nicest reef safe lotion out there, glides on nice and smooth.Keeps me protected while out on my Hobie Cat and lounging by the resort wet bar.

avis.titre: One of the best mineral sunscreens!
avis.texte: This is an amazing mineral sunscreen. Easy to apply, not thick and gloopy. It is actually moisturizing and soothing on the skin. The white cast is very minimal. On my darker skin tone I noticed a slight white sheen on the face but it's not at all noticeable on the body where my skin is a couple shades lighter. My little one's face is a light-medium brown tone and there was no white cast on her face. For the smooth texture, it is also amazing that this is water resistant for 80 minutes. This is going to be my go-to for days when I am outdoors for a long time and/or doing water activities. As a bonus, it is easy to apply on squirmy kids, too, since it doesn't take forever to rub in.

If you're looking for a mineral sunscreen that seamlessly blends, look no further. We started using zinc sunscreens a few years ago, which basically means we've been walking around looking like ghosts since 2017. The Vacation mineral sunscreen gets all the thumbs up from us!!!! So happy to have found this product.

avis.titre: Please make more things so I can buy them.
avis.texte: Goes on smooth, lasts forever. Honestly, I would buy any product you made. You could sell rocks and I would buy them.
Rubs in as well as any mineral based sunscreen I've used. With a light touch you get a nice dry finish. Great for sensitive skin. It has a light innoffensive odour.
Bought it for my sister because she can't use regular sunscreens. She said its the best mineral sunscreen she's ever used.
Silky Smooth - enjoy the mineral protection. Goes on cleanly and absorbs quickly. Stays on in sweat and swimming. Great product, works well and feels good.

avis.titre: Amazing Zinc Sunscreen for the Price
avis.texte: Entirely transparent zinc sunscreen (it doesn't leave a white cast) and it is supremely hydrating. This wouldn't be a good sunscreen for oily skin, but it is perfect for dry skin. I don't have that chalky feeling at the end of the day, and I love that it is fragrance free.

avis.titre: Best vacation product, just pull the trigger.
avis.texte: In addition ton providing the protection I need, this mineral lotion not only feels great while putting on, but it smells great too! My skin has never looked better!
